title: Industry VLSI Trainer (Offline)
jobDescription: We are looking for experienced Industry VLSI Trainers to deliver an intensive offline VLSI Design Bootcamp in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh. The trainer will conduct classroom sessions, provide hands-on training using Cadence EDA tools, mentor students on industry-oriented projects, and deliver practical learning aligned with current semiconductor industry standards. Key Responsibilities Deliver offline classroom sessions on VLSI Design. Conduct practical training using Cadence EDA Tools. Teach the complete RTL-to-GDSII ASIC Design Flow. Mentor students through assignments and capstone projects. Conduct lab sessions and assist students with debugging. Evaluate students through quizzes and practical assessments. Share semiconductor industry best practices and design methodologies. Required Skills Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Cadence Virtuoso Cadence Genus Cadence Innovus Cadence Tempus Cadence Xcelium Cadence Spectre Strong understanding of: CMOS Fundamentals Digital VLSI Design RTL Design (Verilog/System Verilog) Functional Verification ASIC Design Flow Physical Design Static Timing Analysis (STA) Timing Closure Preferred: TCL Scripting Shell Scripting Linux Environment Qualification B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, ECE, VLSI, Microelectronics, or related discipline. Industry experience in Semiconductor/VLSI companies preferred. Prior teaching or corporate training experience is an added advantage. Excellent communication and mentoring skills.
